change: Remove the looping flail and disable all Physics Control pose motors during ragdoll. Preserve simulated bodies, gravity, collision, CCD, joint limits, matched get-up and weapon restoration.
validation_notes: All four suites passed on the final native build.
Settling measures limb positions and rotations over one second, four seconds after landing. Actual drift is checked because contact-solver corrections can spike instantaneous angular velocity.
Paired-action test starts were moved to open floor after passive bodies settled against gym obstacles that correctly blocked get-up. A separate low-ceiling check verifies blocked recovery.
The prior PhysicsInteractionValidation.json motor-enabled check is superseded by this passive-ragdoll behavior. Weapon aiming, carry and parkour suites were not rerun for this change.
limits: Network checks used two-player listen-server PIE without injected latency or packet loss.
Ragdoll limbs simulate locally with server pelvis corrections; full bone poses are not replicated.
Packaged builds and dedicated servers were not tested.

recovery_followup.note: Adds physics-asset motor disabling, per-limb rotational damping and corrected get-up continuity. Shared Artifacts reports now contain the newer runs; the historical results embedded here are preserved.

combat_followup.note: Shared report paths have been rerun for combat death and shoulder switching; original results above remain a historical snapshot.
